data.exact_reserve_text: During 2023, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2021 and prior) decreased by $38.4m due to favourable experience in Syndicate 1919's Tech and Casualty divisions. On a net basis ultimate claims have increased by $0.6m, this is predominantly because the favourable gross experience in Casualty is net nil, due to the loss portfolio transfer on the 2020 & prior years of account. In addition, the Tech classes with favourable experience have been those with significant reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2023 Syndicate 1919 recorded a net release on prior underwriting years: gross ultimate claims for 2021 and prior reduced by $38.4m, driven by favourable claims experience in the Syndicate's Technical (energy/technical risks) and Casualty divisions. The net position was slightly adverse (+$0.6m) due to the impact of a prior Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) ceded in December 2022 which affected recoveries on 2020 and earlier years. Overall the movement is a gross release, with reinsurance arrangements materially influencing the net outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2021 and prior) decreased by $38.4m due to favourable experience in Syndicate 1919's Tech and Casualty divisions.

On a net basis ultimate claims have increased by $0.6m, this is predominantly because the favourable gross experience in Casualty is net nil, due to the loss portfolio transfer on the 2020 & prior years of account.
Favourable claims experience has been observed across the majority of classes and is the material driver for the underwriting profit generated during the year.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures in the report are presented in $000; amounts above converted to millions (divide by 1,000). Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding gross) 2022 column. Prior year development taken from explicit sentence on page 45 (gross decrease $38.4m). Claims development triangle parsed from gross triangle on page 44 (table printed by underwriting year with development ages across columns; converted/transposed to the requested rows-by-development format). 'Technical risks' division mapped to standard LOB 'Energy' for LOB-level mapping by inference. RDS entries are hypothetical realistic disaster scenarios from the report, not actual realised events.
